issues.line_reference: line 259 — font parameter on dot CTkLabel
issues.violation: Raw font tuple ('Segoe UI', 9) used instead of a FONTS token. CLAUDE.md forbids raw font tuples in component files.
issues.fix: Replace font=("Segoe UI", 9) with FONTS["timestamp"] (the dot glyph is small and the timestamp font is the closest semantic match for a tiny inline marker). If no existing token is the right size, raise it with the PM to add a FONTS["dot"] token — do NOT hard-code a new tuple.

positive_notes: The wraplength=900 change specified in AC-6 is a pure layout property and is not a colour, font, or SPACING token — using the integer literal 900 directly is acceptable and consistent with the CLAUDE.md note in spec.json risk_flags.

All colour usage in activity_feed.py correctly references COLORS tokens: COLORS['bg'], COLORS['surface'], COLORS['elevated'], COLORS['border'], COLORS['text'], COLORS['subtext'], COLORS['muted'], and the ctx_* palette keys — no hardcoded hex strings found.

All spacing values use SPACING tokens (SPACING['lg'], SPACING['md'], SPACING['sm'], SPACING['xs'], SPACING['xxl']) and CARD_PAD_X, CARD_PAD_Y, CARD_GAP design constants — no arbitrary pixel values in padding or margin.
Corner radius on ActivityCard uses RADIUS (10) correctly for a primary card surface.
Text hierarchy is correctly applied: COLORS['text'] for activity body, COLORS['subtext'] for the change note, COLORS['muted'] for timestamp and context chip label.
Fonts on all labels other than the dot use FONTS tokens: FONTS['heading'], FONTS['ui'], FONTS['body'], FONTS['timestamp'].
The change label correctly preserves the dot character and '↳  ' prefix as required by the design constraints.
No new imports, widgets, or tokens are introduced in activity_feed.py — scope is confined to wraplength only as specified.
recorder.py and vlm_backends.py contain no UI elements — the prompt text and dtype changes in those files have no design surface to review and are clean from a design perspective.
summary: The planned changes are design-safe. The only wraplength values touched are the two CTkLabel instances at lines 286 and 298, and using the literal 900 for wraplength is explicitly permitted because wraplength is a layout geometry property, not a colour, font, or SPACING token. One pre-existing minor violation was found in the file: the dot glyph label at line 259 uses a raw font tuple ('Segoe UI', 9) rather than a FONTS token. This violation pre-dates this task and the spec does not ask the programmer to change it, but it must not be left to accumulate — it should be addressed in a follow-up. The verdict is approved_with_notes: the programmer may proceed with the wraplength change and the other two file edits; the raw font tuple should be tracked as a design debt item for a subsequent clean-up task.
